summary: Rederiaktiebolaget Gotland (publ), together with its subsidiaries, operates as a passenger shipping company in Sweden. The company owns and operates a fleet of vessels; invests in the transformation of shipping and new technologies; and owns hotels and properties, as well involved in the, commercial and rental properties; and develops markets, and packages travel incentives; and passenger and cargo traffic activities. It also invests in new technology and fossil-free energy solutions. The company was founded in 1865 and is headquartered in Visby, Sweden. Rederiaktiebolaget Gotland (publ) operates as a subsidiary of Trojaborg AB.
